import requests, json, numpy as np, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AIM="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q04516.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
txt=requests.get("https://data.orthodb.org/current/fasta",params={"id":"22973at4891","species":4891},timeout=180).text
seqs={};meta={};cur=None
for l in txt.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith(">"):
        cur=l[1:].split(" ",1)[0]
        try: meta[cur]=json.loads(l[1:].split(" ",1)[1])["organism_name"]
        except: meta[cur]="?"
        seqs[cur]=""
    elif cur: seqs[cur]+=l.strip()

AAs="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0

0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
M=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B.strip().split("\n")],float)
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,-1) for c in s])
GAP=-8.0
def nw_lin(s1,s2):
    """global NW, linear gap, free end gaps on s2; returns 1-based map s1pos -> s2 residue char/pos"""
    a=enc(s1); b=enc(s2); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    Sub=np.where((a[:,None]>=0)&(b[None,:]>=0), M[np.clip(a,0,19)[:,None],np.clip(b,0,19)[None,:]], -1.0)
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9); Mm[0,:]=0.0; Mm[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*GAP
    jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        cand=np.full(m+1,-1e9)
        cand[1:]=np.maximum(Mm[i-1,:-1]+Sub[i-1,:], Mm[i-1,1:]+GAP)
        cand[0]=Mm[i-1,0]+GAP
        t=cand-jj*GAP
        Mm[i,:]=np.maximum.accumulate(t)+jj*GAP
    # traceback
    i,j=n,m; mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(Mm[i,j]-(Mm[i-1,j-1]+Sub[i-1,j-1]))<1e-6:
            mp[i]=(s2[j-1],j); i-=1; j-=1
        elif abs(Mm[i,j]-(Mm[i,j-1]+GAP))<1e-6: j-=1
        else: mp[i]=('-',None); i-=1
    while i>0: mp[i]=('-',None); i-=1
    return mp

POS={122:"R122 (FAD RxY[ST] Arg)",124:"Y124 (si-face stacking Tyr)",125:"T125",
     185:"G185 (pre-GxGxxP)",186:"G186",188:"G188",191:"P191 (GxGxxP)",
     216:"E216 (2'-P pocket, Ncb5or K429 pos)",244:"H244 (cb5r D239 position)",
     245:"K245",256:"Y256 (cb5r F251 position)",278:"C278 (re-face Cys)",312:"F312 (C-term Phe)"}
counts={p:collections.Counter() for p in POS}
per_species={}
ids=list(seqs)
for k in ids:
    mp=nw_lin(AIM,seqs[k])
    for p in POS: counts[p][mp[p][0]]+=1
    per_species.setdefault(meta[k],[]).append({p:mp[p][0] for p in POS})
print("orthologs aligned: %d ; species: %d"%(len(ids),len(per_species)))
print("\n%-42s %-28s %s"%("AIM33 position","top residues (n/186)","%top"))
summary=[]
for p,lab in POS.items():
    c=counts[p]; tot=sum(c.values()); top=c.most_common(4)
    summary.append((p,lab,top[0][0],100*top[0][1]/tot))
    print("%-42s %-28s %.0f%%"%(lab, " ".join(f"{a}:{n}" for a,n in top), 100*top[0][1]/tot))

print("\nAcidic (D/E) frequency at each pocket position:")
for p in [216,244,245,256]:
    c=counts[p]; tot=sum(c.values())
    ac=c['D']+c['E']; bas=c['K']+c['R']; his=c['H']
    print(f"   AIM33 {AIM[p-1]}{p}: D/E {100*ac/tot:5.1f}%   K/R {100*bas/tot:5.1f}%   H {100*his/tot:5.1f}%   S/T {100*(c['S']+c['T'])/tot:5.1f}%")

# N-terminal hydrophobic anchor conservation: Kyte-Doolittle max window over first 70 aa
KD=dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",[1.8,4.2,3.8,4.5,-1.6,2.8,1.9,-0.9,-0.4,-0.8,-0.7,2.5,-1.3,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.9,-4.5,-3.2]))
def maxkd(s,w=19):
    v=[KD.get(c,0) for c in s]
    if len(v)<w: return np.nan
    return max(np.convolve(v,np.ones(w)/w,'valid'))
nt=[maxkd(s[:75]) for s in seqs.values()]
print("\nN-terminal (1-75) max Kyte-Doolittle 19-residue window: AIM33 = %.2f ; orthologs median %.2f, %d/%d >= 1.6 (TM-like)"%(
    maxkd(AIM[:75]), np.nanmedian(nt), sum(1 for x in nt if x>=1.6), len(nt)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.6))
labs=[f"{AIM[p-1]}{p}" for p,_,_,_ in summary]
vals=[v for _,_,_,v in summary]
cols=["#2b6cb0" if p not in (216,244,256) else "#c53030" for p,_,_,_ in summary]
ax.bar(labs,vals,color=cols)
for i,(p,lab,top,v) in enumerate(summary): ax.text(i,v+1.5,top,ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0,110); ax.set_ylabel("% of 186 fungal orthologs with the modal residue")
ax.set_title("Conservation of AIM33 cofactor-site positions across 186 Saccharomycetes orthologs (OrthoDB 22973at4891)")
ax.text(0.98,0.05,"red = NAD(P)H 2'-position pocket",transform=ax.transAxes,ha="right",color="#c53030",fontsize=9)
plt.xticks(rotation=45); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
